 Peter Weber Shares First Look at Twins with Jadeyn Carr, Plus: Pregnancy Updates! 
 Instagram 
 So exciting!
 Bachelor Nation first met Peter Weber on Season 15 of “The Bachelorette” and then again when he returned to our screens as the leading man on Season 24 of “The Bachelor.” 
 While looking for love on-screen didn’t work out for Peter in the long run, he’s been keeping followers updated with his life online.
 Over the summer, the former Bachelor revealed he found love off-screen and hard-launched his relationship with model Jadeyn Carr on social media.
 Then, shortly after, the couple announced that Jadeyn is pregnant and they’re expecting twins!
 Peter and Jadeyn have been posting updates on social media about their adventures as a couple and her pregnancy. 
 Waiting for your permission to load the Instagram Media .
 And recently, the former Bachelor shared a first look at their twins in a new post on Instagram. 
 Peter posted two sonogram pictures, one showing baby “A” and the other showing baby “B.”
 He said, “The twins making their first appearance! Time for some guesses on gender or who they look like more, let’s hear it! ❤️❤️” 
 People filled the comments with their guesses, and Peter’s mom Barbara said, “I love my beautiful grandbabies! The first is definitely you!! And the second is Jadeyn!!❤️❤️”
 Instagram 
 Jadeyn also posted new maternity photos and expressed what pregnancy has meant to her. 
 She said, “Pregnancy is romantic ❤︎ There’s something so precious and raw about what our bodies are capable of. About how much we happily sacrifice for a little soul we haven’t even met yet.”
 The mom-to-be also added, “Through the exhaustion, the body I’m still learning to recognize, the raging hormones (sorry Peter).. this experience has given me a whole new level of admiration for the extraordinary strength and love that comes with growing a baby (or two). Womanhood is a superpower. And I can’t think of anything more romantic than that.”
 We are so excited for Peter, Jadeyn, and their growing family. We can’t wait to meet their twins!
